description: Keep the final reply in the user's conversational language, 2–4 short sentences (25–60 words): report the verified result and ask ONE relevant optional next-step question about ONE action, not a choice menu. Mandatory missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically; respect requests for no suggestions. Saved links let friends join without accounts. If CURRENT received UI context or actual host evidence confirms the same saved plan and last-action module are already open, do not call open_planner again; realtime updates the existing view. Historic context is insufficient. Otherwise open the last-action module with the selected credentials, or honor an explicit opening request. Add, remove or replace one participant's all-day dates and/or exact free-time windows. dates are ALL-DAY answers. For specific hours pass dates=[] and time_slots with absolute ISO start/end including Z/UTC offset, plus the known IANA time_zone. Do not invent a zone or turn partial-day times into all-day answers. add merges windows and replaces all-day markers on touched days with exact hours; remove subtracts intervals (including from all-day dates). With time_slots present, replace replaces ALL availability; without it replace affects only all-day dates and preserves unrelated exact windows. dates add/remove also replace/remove exact windows on those local days. Empty time_slots + replace clears all availability. Read get_plan afterwards. Availability never sets an agreed Event date or RSVP. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

mode.description: add/remove change supplied days/windows; replace is a full replacement when time_slots is supplied. Default replace (legacy all-day behavior).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

time_slots.description: Optional exact windows. For hours-only changes pass dates=[] and mode=add/remove; replace changes the entire availability. End is exclusive.

end.description: ISO timestamp with Z or UTC offset, after start, max 7 days.

start.description: ISO timestamp with Z or UTC offset.

time_zone.description: Known IANA zone such as Europe/Prague; required for time_slots and edits to existing exact windows. Ask if unknown.
